create_linear_expression: create a LinearExpression object with linear coefficients and offset for bound propagation
build_crown_rvt_relaxer: build a CROWN-RVT linear bounds relaxer mapping primitives to predefined linear relaxations for ReLU, sigmoid, exp, abs, and bilinear
build_fastlin_rvt_relaxer: build a FastLin-RVT linear bounds relaxer mapping primitives to parallel bounds relaxations for ReLU, sigmoid, exp, abs, and bilinear
build_parameterized_relaxer: build a parameterized linear bounds relaxer with optimisable relaxation parameters for ReLU, sigmoid, exp, abs, bilinear, and softplus
test_linearized: test the linearized function that returns a linear function tangent to a given function at a primal point
